title: Functional French – Low Intermediate I
prerequisites_raw: FSL106H5 or the equivalent as determined by the department's French Placement Test ( https://frenchpt.utm.utoronto.ca/ )
exclusions_raw: FSL205Y5 or FSL121Y1 or FSL120H1 or FSL122H1 or higher level FSL course. Grade 12 Core French, and all high school grade levels in French Immersion, Extended French, and French Secondary Schools.
